originalText:
第4章 
陈启对着阿泽招了招手，“阿泽，你能帮我挖一下这个吗？”
阿泽蹲下来，看了看那一小片被扒拉开一点泥土的地方，二话不说伸出爪子，三两下就挖出三个半个拳头般大小的东西。
陈启眼睛一亮，忙拿过来上上下下左左右右检查一遍，还拿起一边被扯断了的藤蔓细细看了几回，果然，是以前熟悉的在菜市场上经常买的食物，番薯。
这个世界太多陌生的东西，就算遇到以前经常吃的食物陈启也不敢随便入口，他将其中一个凑到阿泽面前，“阿泽，阿泽，这东西有毒吗？能吃吗？”
阿泽接过来，咬了一口，咀嚼了两下将口中的东西咽了下去，“可以吃。”
“来来来，我们将它烤来吃吧。”陈启兴奋地拉着阿泽回到火堆旁，示意阿泽在旁边再挖一个浅坑。
三条番薯并不大，烤熟后一掰露出里面橘红色的肉，迎面扑来一股浓郁的美味香气。
阿泽耸动了下鼻子，惊奇道：“好香。”
陈启将番薯递给阿泽，“你试试看，剥掉外皮吃。”
阿泽剥掉外皮吃了一口，软软的糯糯的，还有点香甜，忍不住两三口就吃完了，吃完还意犹未尽。
两人吃饱喝足，阿泽背着陈启回到洋槐树最高粗壮的枝干上休息，度过了温馨的一夜。
translatedText:
Chapter 4

Chen Qi waved toward A-Ze. "A-Ze, could you help me dig this up?"

A-Ze squatted down, glancing at the small patch where the soil had been brushed aside. Without a word, he extended his claws and, in just a few quick swipes, dug out three items roughly half the size of a fist.

Chen Qi’s eyes lit up. He hurriedly took them and inspected them from every angle, top to bottom, left to right. He even picked up the snapped vine nearby and examined it closely several times. Sure enough, it was a familiar food he had often bought at the vegetable market in the past—sweet potatoes.

There were far too many unfamiliar things in this world. Even though it was a food he used to eat regularly, Chen Qi did not dare put it into his mouth carelessly. He held one up in front of A-Ze. "A-Ze, A-Ze, is this poisonous? Can we eat it?"

A-Ze took it, took a bite, chewed a couple of times, and swallowed. "It's edible."

"Come on, let's roast them!" Chen Qi excitedly pulled A-Ze back to the campfire and gestured for him to dig another shallow pit beside it.

The three sweet potatoes were not particularly large. Once roasted, breaking one open revealed the vibrant orange-red flesh within, accompanied by a rich, mouthwatering aroma wafting toward them.

A-Ze twitched his nose and marveled, "It smells so good."

Chen Qi handed a sweet potato to A-Ze. "Give it a try. Peel off the skin before you eat it."

A-Ze peeled away the skin and took a bite. It was soft and tender, with a hint of sweetness. Unable to resist, he devoured it in just two or three bites, still left craving more after finishing.

Having eaten and drunk their fill, A-Ze carried Chen Qi on his back up to the highest, sturdiest branch of the locust tree to rest, spending a warm and peaceful night together.
